map.根据火灾类别和使用场景，推荐合适的灭火器类型与配置方案: Recommend suitable extinguisher types and configuration plans by fire class and usage scenario.
map.A类 - 固体物质火灾（木材、纸张、布料）: Class A - solid-material fires (wood, paper, cloth)
map.B类 - 液体或可熔固体火灾（汽油、酒精）: Class B - flammable liquid or meltable solid fires (gasoline, alcohol)
map.C类 - 气体火灾（天然气、丙烷）: Class C - gas fires (natural gas, propane)
map.D类 - 金属火灾（镁、钠、钾）: Class D - metal fires (magnesium, sodium, potassium)
map.E类 - 带电火灾（电气设备）: Class E - energized electrical fires (electrical equipment)
map.F类 - 烹饪油火灾（厨房动植物油）: Class F - cooking-oil fires (kitchen animal/vegetable oils)

map.📚 深度解析：灭火器选型配置: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Extinguisher Selection and Configuration
map.办公室、商铺等场所按火灾种类与危险等级初选灭火器类型与规格。: For offices, shops and similar premises, pre-select the extinguisher type and size by fire class and hazard level.
map.场所改变用途后复核原有配置是否仍匹配新的火灾危险类别。: After a premises changes use, re-check whether the original configuration still matches the new fire-hazard class.
map.消防安全检查中快速核对配置数量与灭火级别是否满足最低要求。: During fire-safety inspections, quickly verify whether the configured quantity and extinguishing rating meet the minimum requirements.
map.办公区 A 类火灾中危险级的选型: Selection for a Class A ordinary-hazard office area
map.按默认参数（A 类火灾、中危险级、保护面积 100 m²）：推荐 ABC 干粉: With the default parameters (Class A fire, ordinary hazard, protected area 100 m²): an ABC dry powder 4 kg unit (versatile, suitable for Class A solid fires) is recommended as the primary choice, with water-based/foam as a supplement; quantity 2 units (1 unit per 75 m² and no fewer than 2), minimum extinguishing rating 2A (GB 50140: 1A/2A/3A for light/ordinary/extra hazard). Clean, residue-free types are preferable in office areas to avoid soiling documents and equipment.
map.ABC 干粉能灭所有火吗？: Can ABC dry powder extinguish every kind of fire?
map.ABC 干粉覆盖 A（固体）、B（液体）、C（气体）类，通用性最强，但不能替代专: ABC dry powder covers Class A (solid), B (liquid) and C (gas) and is the most versatile, but it cannot replace the requirements of specialized locations; for energized-equipment fires the agent's insulating properties must be confirmed, and metal (Class D) fires require a specialty powder and cannot be mixed.
map.为什么最少要 2 具？: Why is a minimum of 2 units required?
map.GB 50140 要求每个设置点不宜少于 2 具，目的是一处失效、压力不足或被火: GB 50140 requires no fewer than 2 units per distribution point, so that a backup remains if one fails, is under-pressurized or is cut off by fire, and distributed placement ensures usable equipment is always near the fire's origin.
map.根据火灾类别（A~F）、使用场所和危险等级，推荐合适的灭火器类型、规格与配置数量: Recommend suitable extinguisher types, sizes and quantities by fire class (A-F), usage location and hazard level.
map.轻危险级：单位灭火级别最大保护面积 U=100m²/A，单具最小 1A: Light hazard: max area per rating unit U = 100 m²/A, minimum 1A per extinguisher
map.中危险级：U=75m²/A，单具最小 2A: Ordinary hazard: U = 75 m²/A, minimum 2A per extinguisher
map.严重危险级：U=50m²/A，单具最小 3A: High hazard: U = 50 m²/A, minimum 3A per extinguisher
map.具数 = max(2, ⌈最小需配灭火级别 Q ÷ 单具灭火级别⌉)；每个计算单: Units = max(2, ⌈required rating Q ÷ unit rating⌉); at least 2 per calculation unit and no more than 5 per setting point (§6.1)
map.按默认参数（A 类火灾、中危险级、保护面积 100 m²）：推荐 ABC 干粉: With defaults (Class A fire, ordinary hazard, 100 m²): 4 kg ABC dry powder is recommended (versatile, suitable for Class A solids), with water-based/foam types as backup; 2 units are required (Q = ⌈100 ÷ 75⌉ = 2A; one 2A unit suffices, but at least 2 per calculation unit), minimum rating 2A (GB 50140-2005 Table 6.2.1: 1A/2A/3A for light/ordinary/high hazard). In offices prefer clean agents with no residue to avoid damaging documents and equipment.
map.GB 50140-2005 §6.1 规定一个计算单元内配置的灭火器数量不得少于: GB 50140-2005 §6.1 requires at least 2 extinguishers per calculation unit and no more than 5 per setting point, so a backup remains if one fails, loses pressure or is cut off by fire, while avoiding over-concentration at one point.
map.配置数量参考（A 类 GB 50140-2005 表 6.2.1；B/C/E 类: Configuration reference (Class A: GB 50140-2005 Table 6.2.1; Classes B/C/E: Table 6.2.2)
map.本工具依据《建筑灭火器配置设计规范》GB 50140 提供参考建议，实际配置须由: This tool provides reference recommendations based on GB 50140; actual configuration must be determined by professionals according to site conditions. GB 55036-2022 (effective 2023-03-01) currently prevails: any mandatory requirement conflicting with GB 50140-2005 follows GB 55036-2022.
map.B/C/E 类（表 6.2.2）：轻危险级 U=1.5m²/B、单具最小 21B: Classes B/C/E (Table 6.2.2): light hazard U=1.5 m²/B, min 21B per unit; ordinary hazard U=1.0 m²/B, min 55B; extra hazard U=0.5 m²/B, min 89B
map.D/F 类：GB 50140 未给出统一的 m²/级别 基准，须按专项规范与灭火: Classes D/F: GB 50140 gives no unified m²/rating basis; determine them from the specific standard and extinguishing-agent type
